title: strange PFCP problem between SMF and UPF on k8s
body: ### Open5GS Release, Revision, or Tag v2.7.5 ### Steps to reproduce I created an open5gs instance on k8s. I did it already some times also in the past Now I'm creating a new one from scratch and I fall into this strange problem. I get continuous error on UPF ERROR: Cannot find PFCP-Node after PFCP association in attach: SMF log UPF log pcap on UPF ```yaml ####### SMF CONFIG logger: level: debug # level: info #
